diagnostics.scope: Office v3 actual rotated floors, apertures, walls and local walker navigation

warnings.message: This is full br.zone design geometry. Unreal import/adapter support is pending; exit lobbies reserve connection points, not generated vertical stair flights.

architecturalRules.name: The visitor entrance opens into reception
The floor has workplaces and essential shared services
Visitor meeting rooms open directly from reception
Reception opens onto meetings or circulation, not staff services
Shared services open from a corridor
Shared services form one clear support group
There are one to three meeting rooms
Work and meeting rooms have conventional proportions
Corridors take no more than 40% of the floor
Corridors are a consistent 2–2.5 m wide
Corridors do not end beyond the last room
Circulation has a loop without crossing staff rooms
Rooms share one consistent ceiling height
The office floor occupies one level
The requested number of independent wings is realized
The requested departmental room program is realized
Maximum cohesion gives contiguous room rows with shared walls

rectangularVariantDifferences: The rectangular variant has a separate orthogonal hub; the full angled design adds its central shared boardroom and focus-room cluster.
